arxiv-2102-07560.title: Bounds for the extremal eigenvalues of gain Laplacian matrices
arxiv-2102-07560.creator: M. Rajesh Kannan, Navish Kumar, Shivaramakrishna Pragada
arxiv-2102-07560.description: Abstract A complex unit gain graph ( 𝕋 \mathbb{T} -gain graph), Φ = ( G , φ ) \Phi=(G,\varphi) is a graph where the function φ \varphi assigns a unit complex number to each orientation of an edge of G G , and its inverse is assigned to the opposite orientation.

arxiv-2109-03659.title: Label Verbalization and Entailment for Effective Zero- and Few-Shot Relation Extraction
arxiv-2109-03659.creator: Oscar Sainz Oier Lopez de Lacalle Gorka Labaka
arxiv-2109-03659.description: Abstract Relation extraction systems require large amounts of labeled examples which are costly to annotate. In this work we reformulate relation extraction as an entailment task, with simple, hand-made, verbalizations of relations produced in less than 15 minutes per relation.

arxiv-2111-04936.title: An Interactive Visualization Tool for Understanding Active Learning
arxiv-2111-04936.creator: Zihan Wang, Jialin Lu, Oliver Snow, Martin Ester
arxiv-2111-04936.description: Abstract Despite recent progress in artificial intelligence and machine learning, many state-of-the-art methods suffer from a lack of explainability and transparency. The ability to interpret the predictions made by machine learning models and accurately evaluate these models is crucially important. In this paper, we present an interactive visualization tool to elucidate the training process of active learning.

arxiv-2206-02973.title: A Mass Dependent Density Profile from Dwarfs to Clusters
arxiv-2206-02973.creator: Antonino Del Popolo, Morgan Le Delliou *
arxiv-2206-02973.description: Abstract In this paper, we extend the work of Freundlich et al. 2020 who showed how to obtain a Dekel–Zhao density profile with mass dependent shape parameters in the case of galaxies. In the case of Freundlich et al. 2020, the baryonic dependence was obtained using the NIHAO set of simulations.

arxiv-2207-02666.title: Free-space point-to-multiplepoint optical frequency transfer with lens assisted integrated beam steering
arxiv-2207-02666.creator: Liang Hu, Ruimin Xue, Xianyi Cao, Jiao Liu, Kan Wu, Guiling Wu, Jianping Chen
arxiv-2207-02666.description: Abstract We report on the realization of high-performance silica integrated two-dimensional lens assisted beam-steering (LABS) arrays along with the first-of-their-kind point-to-multiplepoint optical frequency transfer. The LABS equips with N N antennas and has the capability to produce arbitrary number of output beams with different output angles with the simple control complexity.

arxiv-2210-03180.title: A ResNet is All You Need? Modeling A Strong Baseline for Detecting Referable Diabetic Retinopathy in Fundus Images
arxiv-2210-03180.creator: Tomás Castilla, Marcela S. Martínez, Mercedes Leguía, Ignacio Larrabide, José Ignacio Orlando
arxiv-2210-03180.description: Abstract Deep learning is currently the state-of-the-art for automated detection of referable diabetic retinopathy (DR) from color fundus photographs (CFP). While the general interest is put on improving results through methodological innovations, it is not clear how good these approaches perform compared to standard deep classification models trained with the appropriate settings.

arxiv-2210-13347.title: Repeated measurements on non-replicable systems and their consequences for Unruh-DeWitt detectors
arxiv-2210-13347.creator: Nicola Pranzini, Guillermo García-Pérez, Esko Keski-Vakkuri, Sabrina Maniscalco
arxiv-2210-13347.description: Abstract The Born rule describes the probability of obtaining an outcome when measuring an observable of a quantum system. As it can only be tested by measuring many copies of the system under consideration, it does not hold for non-replicable systems. For these systems, we give a procedure to predict the future statistics of measurement outcomes through Repeated Measurements (RM).

arxiv-2311-09582.title: Quantum Conformal Gravity
arxiv-2311-09582.creator: Ichiro Oda, Misaki Ohta
arxiv-2311-09582.description: Abstract We present the manifestly covariant canonical operator formalism of a Weyl invariant (or equivalently, a locally scale invariant) gravity whose classical action consists of the well-known conformal gravity and Weyl invariant scalar-tensor gravity, on the basis of the Becchi-Rouet-Stora-Tyupin (BRST) formalism.

arxiv-2410-01089.title: FMBench: Benchmarking Fairness in Multimodal Large Language Models on Medical Tasks
arxiv-2410-01089.creator: Peiran Wu, Che Liu, Canyu Chen, Jun Li, Cosmin I. Bercea, Rossella Arcucci
arxiv-2410-01089.description: Abstract Advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly improved medical task performance, such as Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Report Generation (RG). However, the fairness of these models across diverse demographic groups remains underexplored, despite its importance in healthcare.

arxiv-2504-19943.title: SUSY hierarchies of Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians with different detuning parameters
arxiv-2504-19943.creator: İsmail Burak Ateş, Şengül Kuru, Javier Negro
arxiv-2504-19943.description: Abstract The aim of this work is to show how supersymmetric (SUSY) quantum mechanics can be applied to the Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian of quantum optics. These SUSY transformations connect pairs of Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians characterized by different detuning parameters as well as Jaynes-Cummings to anti-Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians.

arxiv-2505-17485.title: keepitsimple at SemEval-2025 Task 3: LLM-Uncertainty based Approach for Multilingual Hallucination Span Detection
arxiv-2505-17485.creator: Saketh Reddy Vemula, Parameswari Krishnamurthy
arxiv-2505-17485.description: Abstract Identification of hallucination spans in black-box language model generated text is essential for applications in the real world. A recent attempt at this direction is SemEval-2025 Task 3, Mu-SHROOM—a Multilingual Shared Task on Hallucinations and Related Observable Over-generation Errors.

arxiv-2507-08375.title: Unsupervised Methods for Video Quality Improvement: A Survey of Restoration and Enhancement Techniques
arxiv-2507-08375.creator: Alexandra Malyugina, Yini Li, Joanne Lin, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
arxiv-2507-08375.description: Abstract Video restoration and enhancement are critical not only for improving visual quality, but also as essential pre-processing steps to boost the performance of a wide range of downstream computer vision tasks. This survey presents a comprehensive review of video restoration and enhancement techniques with a particular focus on unsupervised approaches.

arxiv-2507-12343.title: Logics with the axiom of convergence: complexity with a small number of variables in the language (extended version) The paper was prepared by participants of the Internship Program for Employees and Postgraduate Students of Russian Educational and Scientific Institutions at the HSE University, Facu
arxiv-2507-12343.creator: M. Rybakov, M. Shcherbakov
arxiv-2507-12343.description: Abstract It is known that many modal and superintuitionistic logics are PSPACE \mathrm{PSPACE} -hard in languages with a small number of variables; however, questions about the complexity of similar fragments of many logics obtained by adding various axioms to “standard” ones remain unexplored.

By combining theoretical calculations, quantum

pmc-10694059.title: A 25-years dataset of ageostrophic, Ekman and Stokes surface currents in the Mediterranean Sea (AGESC-Med)
pmc-10694059.creator: Verónica Morales-Márquez, Ismael Hernández-Carrasco, Alejandro Orfila
pmc-10694059.description: A 25-years surface velocity data-set for the Mediterranean Sea is presented in this paper. The velocity data is obtained using a modified Ekman model which allows us to obtain an analytical solution for the surface currents using satellite altimetry and available wind and waves data from synoptic observations.

pmc-11316316.title: Less is more: CRISPR/Cas9-based mutations in DND1 gene enhance tomato resistance to powdery mildew with low fitness costs
pmc-11316316.creator: Ruiling Li, Lei Cui, Matteo Martina, Valentina Bracuto, Fien Meijer-Dekens, Anne-Marie A. Wolters, Andrea Moglia, Yuling Bai, Alberto Acquadro
pmc-11316316.description: Powdery mildew (PM), triggered by Oidium neolycopersici, represents a significant threat and a major concern for the productivity of tomato plants (Solanum lycopersicum L.). The presence of susceptibility (S) genes in plants facilitates pathogen proliferation and their dysfunction can lead to a recessively inherited broad-spectrum and durable type of resistance.

pmc-11432751.title: Wine, Polyphenols, and the Matrix Effect: Is Alcohol Always the Same?
pmc-11432751.creator: Elisabetta Miraldi, Giulia Baini, Marco Biagi, Giorgio Cappellucci, Alessandro Giordano, Federica Vaccaro, Alberto A. E. Bertelli
pmc-11432751.description: While the number of publications on wine and health is steadily increasing, ranging from a molecular level to epidemiological studies, often with contradictory results, little attention has been given to a holistic approach to research, starting from the molecular level to arrive at pharmacological and medical conclusions.

pmc-12577352.title: Women’s Knowledge and Health Care-Seeking Behavior Regarding Pelvic Organ Prolapse in the West Bank, Palestine
pmc-12577352.creator: Doha Khaleel Moheasen, Ibtesam Medhat Mohamad Dwekat, Maha Sudki Nahal, Eman Awad Tayem
pmc-12577352.description: BackgroundPelvic organ prolapse is a prevalent condition affecting women of various ages; however, many remain unaware of this health issue and its potential complications. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, prevalence of reported POP symptoms, and healthcare-seeking behaviour among women in the West Bank.

pmc-12617324.title: Contemporary Antiretroviral Therapy Regimens in People With HIV Who Initiated Treatment in the Pre‐Antiretroviral Therapy Era
pmc-12617324.creator: Eisuke Adachi, Shuhei Okuno, Yoshiaki Kanno, Michiko Koga, Hiroshi Yotsuyanagi
pmc-12617324.description: imens, from the in‐house database, which were subsequently curated by Eisuke Adachi. Conflicts of Interest Eisuke Adachi has received honoraria for lectures and advisory board participation from ViiV Healthcare K.K.

pmc-12618682.title: AMF-responsive nanobiomagnetite for targeted delivery of amphotericin B against Leishmania amazonensis
pmc-12618682.creator: Mariana Verdan, Dirlei Nico, Leandro Sangenito, Flavio Garcia, André L S Santos, Fernanda Abreu
pmc-12618682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cutaneous leishmaniasis remains a neglected tropical disease with limited treatment options. Available therapies include costly and toxic drugs for which recurrent cases of resistance are reported. Drug delivery systems based on the association of approved drugs and nanoparticles have improved pharmacological properties of the drug, such as targeted therapy, enhanced drug solubility, reduced side effects, and potentially lower doses required for effective treatment.

pmc-12718216.title: Diagnostic Utility of Urinary Amylase in Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review
pmc-12718216.creator: Ubaid Ullah, Syed Saad Ali Chishti, Asim Junaid, Marria Sarwar
pmc-12718216.description: Background: Diagnosis of acute pancreatitis (AP) is primarily based on serum amylase and lipase levels, which may normalize rapidly or remain within normal limits in early or late stages. Urinary amylase, with a longer detection window and easier sample collection, may offer a more sensitive diagnostic option, though evidence remains inconsistent.

pmc-12997149.title: Epigenetic Modulation of the ACE System Underlies the Slow Aerobic Muscle Phenotype and Metabolic Exercise Response
pmc-12997149.creator: Flück Martin, Benedikt Gasser, Giraud Marie‐Noëlle
pmc-12997149.description: Epigenetic regulation of the angiotensin‐converting enzyme (ACE)—particularly CpG methylation within its promoter—may modulate gene expression and skeletal muscle adaptation to endurance exercise, complementing the known effects of the ACE I/D polymorphism (rs1799752). We hypothesized that ACE promoter methylation correlates with markers of aerobic metabolism and interacts with genotype and enzyme activity to explain interindividual variability in muscle oxidative capacity.

pmc-13167323.title: Real-world performance of EULAR and GRAPPA definitions of difficult-to-treat psoriatic arthritis within the ORCHESTRA cohort: an observational cohort study
pmc-13167323.creator: Rahaf Zyad Attar, Seyyid Bilal Acikgoz, Elliot Hepworth, Ozun Bayindir Tsechelidis, Ricardo Sabido-Sauri, Tara Swami, Sibel Zehra Aydin
pmc-13167323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Psoriatic arthritis (PsA) is a complex inflammatory disease with significant musculoskeletal, dermatological, and comorbidity burden. Despite therapeutic advances, many patients remain difficult to treat (D2T). Conventional definitions often overlook distinctions between inflammatory and non-inflammatory drivers, risking inappropriate treatment escalation.

pmc-13265492.title: The hidden cost of patient advocacy: moral courage mediating clinical advocacy behaviors and workplace ostracism among Chinese nurses
pmc-13265492.creator: Li Shang, Na Wang, Liping Qin, Ling Song, Suyao Yan, Jin Zhang
pmc-13265492.description: BackgroundPatient advocacy is a central ethical responsibility of nurses and is generally associated with patient protection, safety, and care quality. However, most existing studies have emphasized the benefits of advocacy for patients, whereas relatively little is known about whether advocacy may create interpersonal costs for nurses themselves.

pmc-13405935.title: Analysis of circRNA Differential Expression and ceRNA Network Construction in Yak Mammary Glands Across Different Physiological Stages
pmc-13405935.creator: Zhenyu Zhang, Yongfu La, Xiaoming Ma, Xiaoyun Wu, Min Chu, Pengjia Bao, Xian Guo, Bo Yang, Chunnian Liang
pmc-13405935.description: Simple SummaryYak milk is an important source of nutrition for herders on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. To improve the yield and quality of yak milk, it is necessary to elucidate the mechanisms governing mammary gland development and lactation regulation in yaks. This study collected mammary gland tissue from yaks during three physiological phases—pregnancy, lactation, and non-pregnant—to investigate changes in circRNA expression.

pmc-13608365.title: Dietary Sanguinarine Mitigates Clostridium perfringens-Induced Enteric Challenge in Broiler Chickens: Effects on Productive Performance, Metabolic Status, Antioxidant Capacity, Immune Response, and Intestinal Health
pmc-13608365.creator: Ali R. Al Sulaiman, Ala E. Abudabos
pmc-13608365.description: This study evaluated the efficacy of graded dietary sanguinarine as a phytobiotic alternative for mitigating Clostridium perfringens-induced enteric challenge in broiler chickens. A total of 360 newly hatched Ross 308 broiler chicks were randomly assigned to six treatments: a non-challenged negative control, a challenged positive control, a challenged group supplemented with avilamycin at 0.
